description: Find threads by where their project lives on disk: folders nest, projects sit inside them, and each thread sits under its project. Forks and side chats nest under the thread they came from. Search reads message text as well as titles, shows the matching line under each result, and lists archived matches in their own section. Hover a thread to archive it in one click, or right-click it to open it in a split, copy its link, pin it, or delete it. Optional settings sort bb's project list and indent its new-thread project picker to match the tree.
